title: Iris Species Predictor (Flask API)
description: Trained a Random Forest classifier and deployed it as a web app plus a JSON API. Shows a model can be reached from a browser form and from other programs.

title: Customer Churn Analysis
description: Explored a telecom dataset with Pandas, visualised churn drivers with Matplotlib/Seaborn, and built a logistic-regression model to flag at-risk customers.

title: Spam SMS Classifier
description: Cleaned raw text, built TF-IDF features, and trained a classifier that separates spam from real messages with high precision. Includes a tiny command-line demo.

title: AI Career Toolkit
description: A pure-Python tool that generates a clean resume, a LinkedIn About section, and a personalised interview-prep question bank from a single profile file.
